question: How many contributors worked on 4x-war and why did the work concentrate where it did?
sql:
WITH contributor_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT contributor) AS total_contributors
  FROM v_commit
  WHERE repo_slug = '4x-war'
),
component_stats AS (
  SELECT
    component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT contributor) AS contributors_on_component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT commit_sha) AS commits,
    SUM(insertions + deletions) AS churn
  FROM v_commit_file
  WHERE repo_slug = '4x-war'
  GROUP BY component
)
SELECT
  cs.component,
  cs.contributors_on_component,
  cs.commits,
  cs.churn,
  cc.total_contributors
FROM component_stats cs
CROSS JOIN contributor_count cc
ORDER BY cs.churn DESC
